test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ISRO initiatives, launched with the vision of "Catch them young", aims to introduce school students to space science and technology?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**YUVIKA - Young Scientist Programme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **YUVIKA** stands for **"Young Scientist Programme"**, an initiative by the Indian Space Research Organisation (**ISRO**).
 
• The programme is designed to **inspire and educate school students** about **space science, technology, and applications**.
 
• It aims to **"Catch them young"**, identifying and nurturing young minds with a passion for **space exploration**.&l
